summary: Tested new FortexaRH features: Document Generation Module, Employee Portal, and Bank Files. Backend: 20/21 tests passed (95%). Frontend: All 3 new pages verified working - Documents page shows templates with category filters, Employee Portal shows login form, PayrollV2 shows bank selector integration.

minor.issue: Test skipped - no employee with document_number available for full login flow test

integration_issues.issue: Console shows 405 errors on page load - likely OPTIONS preflight requests being rejected

critical_code_review_comments: Document Generation Module correctly implemented with 5 default templates for Dominican Republic HR documents
Templates use Handlebars-style variables {{variable_name}} for placeholder replacement
Employee Portal has separate JWT authentication with 'portal_type: employee' claim
First-time employee login uses cédula as password - good UX for onboarding
Bank Files module supports 3 Dominican banks: Popular, BHD León, Banreservas
Bank file generation correctly validates period status (approved/paid only)
All new routers use init_router() pattern for database and auth dependency injection

test_credentials.employee_portal: Uses employee's cédula as both username and initial password

seed_data_creation: Used existing TEST_Loan Employee for document generation tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: New features fully tested: 1) Document Generation at /api/doc-generator/* - 5 default templates (constancia_trabajo, carta_recomendacion, certificado_ingresos, notificacion_aumento, carta_terminacion), 4 categories (constancia, carta, certificado, notificacion). 2) Employee Portal at /api/employee-portal/* - separate auth system using employee cédula, endpoints for profile, payslips, vacations, loans, dashboard. 3) Bank Files at /api/bank-files/* - supports Popular, BHD, Banreservas banks, generates files for approved/paid periods only.
